title: Tracybot: Preserving Developer Intent by Tracing Agent-Generated Code to Prompts
title_zh: Tracybot：通过将智能体生成的代码追溯到提示词来保留开发者意图

paragraphs.en: Tracybot 是集成 VS Code、Git 与编码智能体的开源工具，可将智能体代码变更追溯至对话提示词以保留开发者意图。 Large language models (LLMs) are now widely used in software development, and LLM-based coding agents are given increasing autonomy. With coding agents, many design decisions are made in the conversation between the developer and the agent. Typically, the developer starts a conversation with an agent and states their intent, the agent proposes options if needed, and the developer plans the change accordingly. Then, the resulting code is committed. However, in such scenarios, the decisions and the intent behind the changes remain in the conversation, with no link to the code they produced. In this paper, we present Tracybot, an open-source tool that integrates with VS Code, Git, and coding agents to keep track of relevant conversations in an LLM-assisted development process. Tracybot captures each change as a Tasklet which consists of optional planning prompts used to plan a change, together with a build prompt that produces it. Tracybot has two main features: (i) it maps line-level code changes made by coding agents to the Tasklets that produced them, and (ii) it allows the developer to export a Tasklet as a decision record when needed, for example when the decision concerns the architecture of the project. We developed the tool over two iterations of a design science study, while focusing the evaluation on the usability and user-friendliness of the tool. In a focus group (7 participants) and a survey (24 participants), we found that Tracybot was perceived as useful for activities like code review, and most participants found our Tasklet design and presentation to be a clear way to represent the developer's intent. Tool: https://github.com/TracyTeam/tracybot. Video: https://youtu.be/Vg_a1F5eO04.
paragraphs.zh: Tracybot 是一个集成 VS Code、Git 与编码智能体的开源工具，可将智能体的代码变更追溯至对话中的提示词，以保留开发者的意图。大语言模型（LLM）如今已广泛应用于软件开发，基于 LLM 的编码智能体正被赋予越来越多的自主权。 借助编码智能体，许多设计决策是在开发者与智能体的对话中做出的。 典型的流程是：开发者发起与智能体的对话并陈述其意图，智能体在需要时提出可选方案，开发者据此规划变更。 然后，生成的代码被提交。 然而，在这类场景中，决策以及变更背后的意图仍留在对话里，与它们所产生的代码之间没有任何关联。 在本文中，我们提出了 Tracybot，一个集成 VS Code、Git 与编码智能体的开源工具，用于在 LLM 辅助的开发过程中追踪相关对话。 Tracybot 将每次变更捕获为一个 Tasklet，它由用于规划变更的可选规划提示词以及生成该变更的构建提示词组成。 Tracybot 有两个主要功能：（i）它将编码智能体所做的行级代码变更映射到产生这些变更的 Tasklet；（ii）它允许开发者在需要时将 Tasklet 导出为决策记录，例如当该决策涉及项目架构时。 我们在设计科学研究（design science study）的两轮迭代中开发了该工具，并将评估重点放在工具的可用性与易用性上。 在一项焦点小组研究（7 名参与者）和一项问卷调查（24 名参与者）中，我们发现 Tracybot 被认为对代码评审等活动很有用，并且大多数参与者认为我们的 Tasklet 设计与呈现方式是表达开发者意图的一种清晰方式。 工具：https://github.com/TracyTeam/tracybot。 视频：https://youtu.be/Vg_a1F5eO04。
